_comment: GLOBAL PDK GUIDELINE for this project. Exactly one PDK is active at a
time: whatever 'selected' names. Every script and skill that needs a
process-specific fact -- a model name, a GDS layer number, a tool path --
reads it from here instead of hardcoding it, so retargeting the whole
flow to another process is a one-word edit to 'selected'.
To add a PDK: add an entry under 'pdks' with the same keys, then point
'selected' at it. To change PDK: edit 'selected' only. Do not hardcode a
process name anywhere else -- see .claude/reference/pdk_config.py for the

layers._comment: GDS layer numbers. Process assignments -- nothing in a netlist implies them, which is why they live here rather than in code.

rules._comment: Process rules that are not per-glayer widths/spacings, so glayout's get_grule() does not carry them. Read through pdk_config, never hardcoded at a call site.

_comment: Top thick-metal stack for spiral inductors. This cannot come from glayout:
sky130_mapped shifts every glayer name down one (glayout 'met5' resolves to
GDS 71/20, the real met4) and never defines 72/20 at all, so its get_grule()
would hand back met4's 0.3/0.4um rules for a layer whose real minimums are
1.6/1.6um. Every number below is read off libs.tech/magic/sky130A.tech.
Note also that 'coil' sits ABOVE routing_layers -- the router never uses it,
so an inductor here cannot collide with routed nets.

physical._comment: Sheet resistances are magic's 'resist' entries in milliohm/square; via_res is the per-cut 'contact via4' value in milliohm. Cap terms are magic's defaultareacap/defaultperimeter for metal5 to substrate.

models._comment: The PDK's three fixed inductor macro-models. They ship as SPICE only -- there is no .mag, no .lef, and no ind_* cell in libs.ref/sky130_fd_pr/gds/sky130_fd_pr.gds; sky130A.tech lists sky130_fd_pr__ind_* under 'not extracted, represented only by script-generated subcells' and that script was never released. Ports are (a b ct sub); l_total_nH is the a-to-b series value (two halves, no K statement).

layers._comment: UNVERIFIED -- placeholders copied in shape from sky130, not confirmed against the gf180 layer map. Confirm against the PDK before trusting any extraction on this process.

rules._comment: UNVERIFIED -- gf180 latch-up limit not confirmed against the PDK. null means the tap-distance check does not run on this process.

gf180mcuD._inductor_comment: No thick-metal stack confirmed for gf180 yet. null means the inductor generator refuses to run on this process rather than inventing layer numbers.
